design.summary: An engineering organization in a box: navigate the system, understand actual work, and steer its agents from one repo-grounded cockpit.
constraints: Keep graph perspectives coordinated without merging their meanings.
Distinguish working, built and deployed observations.

design.summary: Keep the operator oriented while switching graphs, tasks, source and agent work.
constraints: Navigation preserves dirty source, cursor and graph cameras.
Late results must not override newer navigation.

connections.label: Files & target definitions
connections.detail: The cockpit asks the repository capability to open an observed file or build declaration. The canonical source broker and current navigation authority choose the bytes; a graph label alone is not a path.

connections.label: Design & task documents
connections.detail: An explicit selection opens a design or task document while retaining source buffers and independent graph cameras. It does not edit a plan or change a task's status.

connections.label: Conversations & steering
connections.detail: Selecting an agent opens its conversation and existing controls. Sending is a separate deliberate action through that agent's actual execution owner.

design.summary: Version the design hierarchy and Ditz dependency graph; deliberately attach task context to a fixed draft.
constraints: Read tasks at a fixed metadata revision.
Refreshing metadata must not silently retarget an attached draft.

connections.label: Plans & pinned task reads
connections.detail: The local core reads the working plan index and identifies its contents; Ditz reads are pinned to a specified Git metadata revision. Refresh can update the view but cannot silently retarget an attached draft.

connections.label: Fixed task/source context
connections.detail: A deliberate attachment carries revision-pinned task text alongside the draft's fixed source. Core preparation materializes and revalidates that context; merely selecting a task does not launch an agent.

design.summary: Read and steer registered conversations, or start Codex with New agent, a message and Enter. Each admitted run captures its selected worktree and retains its own controls and saved messages.
constraints: Observing a terminal does not launch or take ownership of it.
Keep uncertain messages and receipts; never resend automatically.

connections.label: Owned runs & terminal sends
connections.detail: Native controls call the IDE-owned app-server. Terminal sends queue to the checked existing session instead; they do not resume a second conversation or transfer ownership of the TUI.

connections.label: Agent operations & edits
connections.detail: Registered transcript events and native activity carry the originating session and worktree into Activity. Recorded edits and current Git diffs remain distinct; meaningful turn boundaries feed Work Log summarization.

design.summary: Read timestamped commands and edits separately from concrete accomplishments retained in repo task history.
constraints: Opening the Work Log does not start a summarizer.
Recording an outcome adds one note; it does not close the issue.

connections.label: Open responsible agent
connections.detail: Clicking an event or saved outcome selects its exact registered agent. This navigates the cockpit; it does not start a model, send a message or alter the agent lifecycle.

connections.label: Latest saved summary
connections.detail: App shares one Work Log observation with the agent rail. The latest saved outcome for the exact session ID appears below its current lifecycle; a historical summary does not decide whether the agent is working now.

connections.label: Record outcome note
connections.detail: The explicit Record outcome action appends one idempotent Ditz comment to a known already-closed issue. It never closes an issue or infers completion from a summary.

design.summary: Route validated requests from the sandboxed renderer to registered local capabilities and preserve recoverable state.
constraints: Filesystem and process access goes through the typed local core.
Older results must not replace newer source state.

connections.label: Filesystem, Git & Bazel results
connections.detail: The matching typed response returns bytes or observations with source identity and freshness. This is the return direction of Repository & build queries, not an independent service dependency.

connections.label: Owned runs / observed sessions
connections.detail: Native run state comes from an IDE-owned process. Registered terminal state comes from reading the existing owner's transcript and checking its identity. The dispatcher reports both without claiming ownership of terminal processes.

contextRefs.note: State assumptions; keep truth and authority explicit.
Actual registered repository entries; missing coverage remains unavailable.
Explicit navigation authority must survive asynchronous reads without stealing later user intent.

nodes.title: Turn repo tasks into bounded agent context

contextRefs.note: A repo-authored briefing connects intent, contract and lessons; linked documents are not automatically included in prepared context.
Metadata revision, issue blob and canonical task bytes are separate from working source selection.
Navigation must not retarget a draft; metadata advancement requires explicit refresh, reattachment and preparation.

contextRefs.note: Pinned Ditz relationships carry missing, cyclic and asymmetric diagnostics.
